breve: A material that processes blit calls to a DrawableTexture.
descricao: A material resource that can be used by DrawableTextures when processing blit calls to draw.

propriedades.desc: The manner in which the newly blitted texture is blended with the original DrawableTexture.

constantes.desc: Mix blending mode. Colors are assumed to be independent of the alpha (opacity) value.
No blending mode, direct color copy.
